privacyPageIntro: This policy explains in plain language which data gsubs needs for transcripts, captions, exports, accounts, feedback, operational diagnostics, and credit purchases.
privacyCollectionBody: We process the video you select, its audio, generated captions, and export settings. If you create an account, we also store basic profile details and the status of your jobs. When you sign in with Google, these details may include the name, email address, and profile-image URL provided by Google. If you use the feedback widget, we also process the message content and category, the page path without its query or fragment, and limited abuse-prevention data. To find bugs and keep the service reliable, GSUBS also records a fixed set of product-action codes, coarse page and viewport categories, job-state counts, HTTP status categories, and sanitized error types. These operational records never include subtitle text, media, filenames, email, account identifiers, IP addresses, cookies, raw error messages, stack traces, keystrokes, or session replay. Data comes mainly directly from you and, when you choose the relevant features, from Google for identity and Stripe for payment and billing-address information.
privacyRetentionBody: GSUBS keeps source media, captions, exports, and the project record in its live local server workspace. That live workspace is automatically deleted 24 hours after the last editing or export activity; each new edit or export refreshes the window. Deleting a project from History removes the live GSUBS copy immediately. Content-free operational events are retained locally for up to 7 days; active presence is held only in server memory for about 90 seconds after the latest visible-page heartbeat and is lost on restart. Encrypted GSUBS recovery backups expire within the configured bounded period, currently 14 days. Pseudonymous erasure records are retained for 30 days. While the current continuity journal remains available, those records are replayed before any restore is allowed online to prevent deleted projects and accounts from returning. If the whole host or current continuity journal is lost, the service must remain offline and user data must not be restored from backup. ElevenLabs copies are governed separately below and are not covered by this 24-hour local-workspace period.
privacyLawfulBasisTitle: 3. Why and on what legal basis we process data
privacyLawfulBasisBody: We process account details, uploaded media, job settings, and purchased-credit activity as necessary to provide the service and perform our contract with you. We process security, abuse-prevention, support, content-free diagnostics, and service-integrity records for our legitimate interests in reliability and bug repair, after considering your rights and minimizing the data. We retain tax, accounting, payment, and consumer-contract records to comply with legal obligations and establish or defend legal claims. Where processing requires consent, you may withdraw it prospectively at any time.
privacyProvisionBody: Email and sign-in details are required for the account; media and settings for the requested job; billing details only for a purchase. Without them we cannot perform that specific feature or purchase, but unrelated features remain available. GSUBS does not make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects, and it does not create advertising profiles.
privacyChildrenTitle: 5. Children, third-party content, and model training
privacyChildrenBody: The service is not directed at children. Anyone without legal capacity must use it only with a parent or guardian's involvement and permission; purchases require legal capacity or valid authority. If content includes other people or their personal data, you must have a lawful right, appropriate notice, and any necessary permission. Do not upload sensitive data unless necessary and lawful. Ascentia does not use your files, audio, or captions to train its own AI models; external providers follow the contracts and settings below.
privacyPaymentsBody: GSUBS offers one-off paid-credit purchases through Stripe-hosted Checkout. Stripe processes the buyer's name, email address, billing address, and payment details, while Ascentia does not receive or store the full card number or CVC. GSUBS retains the minimum transaction and billing evidence needed for support, withdrawal handling, refunds, and accounting reconciliation.
privacyFinancialRetentionBody: Each Stripe payment is manually matched to the tax document actually issued through AADE e-Timologio. Necessary payment and tax-document data, such as amount, VAT, Stripe references, document series and number, and MARK, is retained through the end of the fifth full year after the relevant tax year and longer only when required by law or an active tax or payment dispute. A Stripe receipt is payment evidence, not an AADE tax document. Account deletion does not erase records whose retention is legally required.
privacyProvidersBody: Application, database, and encrypted-backup infrastructure is hosted with Hetzner in Germany. To provide transcription, GSUBS sends the extracted audio to ElevenLabs Scribe v2, which acts as a processor. After copying the result locally, GSUBS requests immediate deletion of the provider transcript. GSUBS records the provider transcript identifier in its dedicated 30-day deletion journal so that deletion can be retried and replayed after an interruption. ElevenLabs-side retention, residual backups, subprocessors, and international transfers follow the applicable service agreement, Data Processing Addendum, account settings, and transfer safeguards; they are not covered by GSUBS's 24-hour local-workspace period. Standard ElevenLabs service may store data in the United States, and GSUBS does not represent Zero Retention Mode or EU data residency as active unless separately verified and disclosed. Stripe receives payment and billing data, Google receives authentication data when you choose Google sign-in, Google Workspace delivers business email and feedback notifications, and AADE e-Timologio receives data required for tax documents actually issued. Where a provider processes data outside the EEA, the available lawful transfer mechanism under the relevant agreement applies, such as an adequacy decision or Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacyFeedbackBody: Feedback is stored first in the protected GSUBS inbox and then delivered as an email notification to the product owner, with safe retries after temporary failures. We use a pseudonymous key to limit abuse and duplicate submissions; the raw network address is not stored on the feedback message. If you are signed in, the submission is linked to your account and your name and email address are included in the notification so we can reply. Anonymous submissions contain no contact details. Live inbox records are deleted automatically within 180 days or earlier when the linked account is deleted. An email copy that has already been delivered may remain temporarily for as long as needed to review and resolve the matter; you may ask for its deletion. Do not include passwords, payment details, or other sensitive information in the message.
privacyChoicesBody: From account settings, you can export your personal data, delete individual jobs, or permanently delete your account. You may also ask Ascentia for access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection where the law provides those rights, and withdraw consent where consent applies. We will respond without undue delay and normally within one month after verifying your identity and request. Some tax, accounting, payment, or legal records cannot be erased before their lawful period ends. You may lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority at www.dpa.gr.
privacyCookiesTitle: 11. Strictly necessary cookies and local storage
privacyCookiesBody: We use only strictly necessary cookies and browser storage for sign-in, security, language, and continuity of your current work. First-party operational diagnostics do not set an analytics cookie or persist their temporary presence identifier in browser storage. We do not use third-party analytics, advertising, cross-site tracking, or other optional cookies, so we do not display a consent banner. If that changes, optional tools will not activate before valid informed consent is given.

termsPaidCreditsScopeBody: Online GSUBS credit purchases are available only to consumers with a billing address in Greece. Each purchase is one-off, with no subscription or automatic renewal, and the displayed final price includes 24% VAT. An eligible payment method is temporarily authorized in Stripe-hosted Checkout. Capture and credit delivery occur only after the Greek billing address and exact purchase evidence are validated from the signed Stripe event. If validation fails, the authorization is canceled; the temporary hold may remain visible for a period determined by the payment method provider or issuer. The Stripe receipt evidences payment, while the tax document is issued manually through AADE e-Timologio and linked by series, sequential number, and MARK.
termsRefundsBody: There are no automatic refunds or discretionary refunds merely because the user changed their mind or did not use the credits. This does not restrict any mandatory consumer right, including where applicable withdrawal, non-conforming performance, or a duplicate or unauthorized charge. Every request is recorded and reviewed manually. If approved, the refund is performed manually in Stripe and the required tax adjustment document is issued and recorded manually in AADE; submitting a request does not automatically perform any financial or tax action.
termsWithdrawalBody: A consumer may notify withdrawal within 14 days after the contract is concluded where the right applies. If the consumer expressly requested that the service begin before the period ends and part of the service has already been supplied, a proportionate amount may be due for the supplied part. The right is lost only after full performance and when the legal conditions have been met. Notice may be submitted from the account or to info@ascentia-gp.com and receives an immutable receipt acknowledgement.
